positions.name: OrchardGraftingTimingAndEvidence
positions.frame: when in the year should the orchard's rootstock be grafted, and what evidence about rootstock state and graft take decides it?
positions.why: The single statement carries a whole frame on its own. It moves the grafting window and gives its grounds in the same breath: the rootstock is still dormant in February, and last year's February trial row took at twice the rate of the March grafts. The 1 October call's late-March timing is unplaced and has no position above it, so there is no existing position to attach to or revise. The directional reads agree that the case is made by evidence rather than authority. No existing narrative leaf or stratum is about grafting, so no home is proposed.
